item.title: Marco Rubio heads to Europe to try to garner support for the Iran war
item.summary: Representatives from G7 countries gather in France, where U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is expected to try to shore up support from reticent allies for the Trump administration's war on Iran.

item.title: How long will the war last? No one knows, and it's making oil prices weird
item.summary: It's like the "Schrödinger's cat" thought experiment. There are two very different potential realities, and traders don't yet know which one is true.

item.title: Our quiz writer made yet another Tom Bombadil reference this week. Can you spot it?
item.summary: How well do you know your "Lord of the Rings"? What about AI, Washington landmarks and TSA wait times? Find out!

item.title: Strangers forge a powerful bond after a car crash in 'Miroirs No. 3'
item.summary: After the sudden death of her boyfriend, a young Berlin woman is taken in by a family she meets in the countryside. In showing the ache of love and loss, Miroirs No. 3 holds up a mirror to us all.

item.title: House panel finds Florida Democrat guilty of ethics violations
item.summary: The House Ethics Committee has found evidence that Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick violated House rules. This comes after the panel held a rare public hearing to review investigations into allegations against the Florida Democrat.

item.title: Here's some new dirt on an unusual source of antibiotic resistance
item.summary: New research suggests drought can stoke antibiotic resistance in soil bacteria — and that can have an impact on humans.

item.title: Scientists watch sperm whales work as a team to assist a birth
item.summary: An unprecedented look at the birth of a sperm whale found that mother and calf were supported by other whales throughout the process.

item.title: These trees brought a fishery back from the brink. They can help you too
item.summary: A community fishery in Cambodia was struggling. There weren't enough fish to make ends meet, until local fishermen started planting a specific type of tree.

item.title: Her dad's dementia inspired her to create a guide for family caregivers
item.summary: Wambūi Karanja of Kenya is "one to watch," says the Alzheimer's Association. Coping with her dad's condition inspired her to develop a training program for families on the art of caregiving.

item.title: Americans seek redemption at figure skating worlds, just weeks after the Olympics
item.summary: Figure Skating World Championships in Prague end on Saturday. Americans Amber Glenn and Ilia Malinin are within medals' reach after disappointing finishes at last month's Olympics.
